products.name: Mulberry Silk Scarf · Azure
products.summary: A square scarf cut from Taihu-basin mulberry silk — cool slip, quiet weight.
products.summaryZh: 太湖流域桑蚕丝裁成的方巾——清凉的滑，安静的重量。
products.story: Printed on mulberry silk filament cloth. The hand is cool at first touch; the knot holds without plastic spring-back. Material: Mulberry Silk (Taihu).
products.storyZh: 印于桑蚕丝长丝织物。第一触偏凉；打结无塑料回弹。材料：桑蚕丝（太湖湖丝）。

products.name: Mulberry Silk Scarf · Ink Geometry
products.nameZh: 桑蚕丝巾 · 墨白几何
products.summary: Black-and-ivory geometry on mulberry silk — structure held in a soft filament.
products.summaryZh: 黑与象牙色的几何落在桑蚕丝上——结构藏在柔软长丝里。
products.story: Concentric geometry printed on mulberry silk. Wear it for the light on the filament face, not for a logo. Material: Mulberry Silk (Taihu).
products.storyZh: 同心几何印于桑蚕丝。为长丝面上的光而戴，不为商标。材料：桑蚕丝（太湖湖丝）。

products.name: Mulberry Silk Scarf · Earth
products.summary: Espresso, mustard, and olive blocks on mulberry silk — colour that moves with the drape.
products.summaryZh: 深棕、芥黄与橄榄色块落在桑蚕丝上——颜色跟随垂感移动。
products.story: Block geometry on Taihu mulberry silk. The filament face catches light in the folds; the reverse stays soft on skin. Material: Mulberry Silk (Taihu).
products.storyZh: 块面几何落于太湖桑蚕丝。长丝面在褶皱里接光；反面贴肤仍柔。材料：桑蚕丝（太湖湖丝）。

materials.name: Baby Cashmere
materials.blurb: The first combing of young cashmere goats — rare, fine, and exceptionally soft.
materials.blurbZh: 幼羊绒的第一次梳绒——稀有、细腻、极为柔软。

materials.name: French Linen
materials.blurb: Flax grown and woven with cool hand and lasting drape.
materials.blurbZh: 凉爽手感与持久垂坠的亚麻织造。

materials.name: Sea Island Cotton
materials.blurb: Extra-long staple cotton prized for silk-like luster.
materials.blurbZh: 超长绒棉，以丝绸般光泽著称。

materials.name: Vegetable Tanned Leather
materials.blurb: Plant-tanned hides that deepen with time and touch.
materials.blurbZh: 植物鞣制，随时间与触感逐渐加深。

materials.name: Japanese Denim
materials.blurb: Shuttle-loom selvedge with irregular character and slow fade.
materials.blurbZh: 梭织赤耳，不规则纹理与缓慢褪色。

materials.name: Horween Leather
materials.originZh: 美国 / 意大利工坊常用
materials.blurb: Chicago tannery leather known for rich pull-up and durability.
materials.blurbZh: 芝加哥鞣革厂出品，以丰富 pull-up 与耐用著称。

materials.name: Vicuna
materials.blurb: One of the rarest animal fibers — reserved for exceptional pieces.
materials.blurbZh: 最稀有的动物纤维之一——仅用于非凡之作。

materials.name: Mulberry Silk (Taihu)
materials.blurb: Fine mulberry silk from the Taihu lake region — luminous, resilient, and central to Chinese textile heritage.
materials.blurbZh: 太湖流域桑蚕丝——光泽细腻、韧性出色，是中国纺织遗产的核心材料。

materials.name: Yak Wool
materials.blurb: Warm, breathable plateau fiber with quiet luxury and resilience.
materials.blurbZh: 青藏高原牦牛绒——温暖透气，安静的奢华与韧性。

materials.name: Ramie (Xia Bu)
materials.blurb: Bast fiber for Xia Bu summer cloth — cool hand, crisp structure, and lasting breathability.
materials.blurbZh: 夏布原料苎麻——凉爽挺括、透气持久。

materials.name: Han Hemp
materials.blurb: Chinese hemp valued for strength, moisture management, and honest texture.
materials.blurbZh: 汉麻——强韧、导湿，纹理诚实。

materials.name: Alxa Bactrian Camel Wool
materials.blurb: Rare Bactrian camel underwool from Alxa — warm, light, and deeply local.
materials.blurbZh: 阿拉善双峰驼绒——稀有、轻暖，地域性极强。

materials.name: Raw Lacquer (Da Qi)
materials.blurb: Tree sap lacquer for urushi craft — durable, deep, and patient in finishing.
materials.blurbZh: 天然生漆（大漆）——坚韧深沉，成器需耐心。
